role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 足智多谋的黑暗贤者擅长操控敌人的方位。他可以创造真空，把敌人卷入盟友的攻击中，再将他们扯入复制之墙中，让敌人身受自身之力的反噬。
hero_summary_en: Versatile and strategic, Dark Seer excels at manipulating the positions of his enemies. Vacuuming foes into the attacks of his allies, he can turn enemy strength against itself by pulling foes through his replicating wall.

abilities.name: dark_seer_vacuum
abilities.description_zh: 黑暗贤者在目标区域制造一个真空环境，将周围的敌方单位吸入，具有打断效果并造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Dark Seer creates a vacuum over the target area that sucks in enemy units, disrupting them and dealing damage.
notes_zh: 此技能可以打断持续施法。
牵引过程为%duration%秒，伤害在牵引后产生。
真空中央附近的树木将会被摧毁。
notes_en: Pulls units over %duration% seconds before dealing damage.
Trees near the center of the vacuum will be destroyed.

abilities.name: dark_seer_ion_shell
abilities.description_zh: 将目标用一个尖刺之盾包裹起来，对周围的敌人造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield that damages enemy units in an area around it.
notes_zh: 每%tick_interval%秒造成一次若干伤害。
离子外壳对其作用单位没有伤害。
如果对已经套上离子外壳的单位再次施放，新的离子外壳会取代旧的。
notes_en: Deals small amounts of damage in %tick_interval% second intervals.
Doesn't damage the target it is cast on.
If cast on a unit that already has Ion Shell, the new Shell replaces the old one.

abilities.name: dark_seer_surge
abilities.description_zh: 为一个友方目标注入能量，使其在短时间内移动速度爆发，并且获得相位移动状态。允许单位达到移动速度上限，并且无法被减速。
abilities.description_en: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.
notes_zh: 奔腾的单位不受减速影响，除非奔腾效果消失。
notes_en: Units with Surge cannot be slowed unless the Surge effect is removed.

shard_loc.en: Surged units leave behind a %trail_radius% radius trail that lasts %trail_duration%s, slows enemies around it by %trail_move_slow%%% and deals %trail_damage% damage per second in %trail_damage_interval%s intervals. Can be put on alt-cast to disable the trail.
shard_loc.zh: 奔腾单位的身后留下一道路径，作用范围为%trail_radius%，持续%trail_duration%秒，对附近的敌人造成%trail_move_slow%%%减速，并且每秒造成%trail_damage%点伤害，伤害间隔为%trail_damage_interval%秒。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），禁止留下路径。

abilities.name: dark_seer_normal_punch
abilities.description_zh: 被动技能。使黑暗贤者下次对英雄的攻击具有克敌机先效果，可以打出目标的复制体，并且根据过去%recent_duration%秒内黑暗贤者的移动距离造成伤害和眩晕。移动%max_distance%距离以上将造成最大威力。
abilities.description_en: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past %recent_duration% seconds. Max power is reached after %max_distance% distance moved.

abilities.name: dark_seer_aggrandize
abilities.description_zh:
黑暗贤者从每点智力获得%int_to_atkspd%攻击速度。

黑暗贤者升级时会恢复最大生命值和魔法值的一定百分比。
abilities.description_en:
Dark Seer gains %int_to_atkspd% Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.

abilities.name: dark_seer_wall_of_replica
abilities.description_zh: 制造一堵扭曲的光墙，对穿过的敌方英雄造成伤害和减速，并复制一个其自身的幻象，幻象由黑暗贤者控制，持续到光墙消失，或者被敌人消灭。
abilities.description_en: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.
notes_zh: 每堵光墙同一时间产生的为一名英雄产生的幻象只有一个。
notes_en: Doesn't create illusions from other illusions.
There cannot be more than one illusion per player per wall.
